prompt:
Use the attached clay render as the exact blueprint. Keep every wall, opening, window, cornice, skirting, floor and ceiling line, the camera, and the position, size and angle of every furniture piece and built-in exactly as in the clay: WC on its 110 cm limestone ledge x 0.137-0.398 y 0.531-0.949; 80 x 115 cm fluted glazing x 0.208-0.338 y 0.142-0.486; shower fittings x 0.712-0.769; 110 cm oak vanity at the right edge from x 0.897, y 0.595 down. Move, resize, add or remove nothing; never enlarge a piece to fill the frame or to match a cut-out. Each placeholder shape marks one product below; render it there at the stated size. Only turn the clay into real materials and light. x, y are fractions of the image from the top-left.

1. PHOTO. Scandinavian interiors magazine: a Nordic bathroom, 3 pm mid-winter, 24 mm shift lens at 1.15 m, level, straight verticals, all sharp. Hero: the linen shower curtain gathered at the shower corner, right third, honed limestone and the niche behind it. Oak and limestone on warm white walls, matte black details, one soft sage fern.

CUT-OUTS. Images 1-2 are cut-outs of a photograph of this room from this camera (1 WC block, ledge, candle, diffuser, roll stand; 2 shower corner, curtain, niche, dispensers): materials, colours and light only, never framing or scale. Images 3-11: close-ups of the exact products: match form, colour and texture.

2. LIGHT. One key: soft winter daylight through the fluted window on the left, no sun; the fluted glass is the brightest surface, glowing, every rib readable, no view, no snow. Exposed for white: the wall beside the window clean white, a step under the glass; the room falls off smoothly to the right. The curtain's folds lit on their left faces, soft shadow inside each fold. Every object: a lit left face, a shadow side a stop darker, dense contact shadows. Ceiling a touch darker, darkest top right. Real contrast, never milky. 4000 K: walls warm white, never orange, pink or grey; the limestone pale oat. Lamps 2700 K, low, shadowless: the wall lamp and the lamp cut at the right edge wash the wall in soft fans up and down; the shower downlight glows low on the limestone.

3. MATERIALS. Washable matte mineral paint #F4F1EC. Floor large matte limestone-look porcelain. Shower corner, niche and WC ledge: honed pale oat limestone, open pores, matte, a soft window highlight along the ledge top. Wall-hung matte white WC, matte black flush plate, rain head, mixer and ceiling track.

4. PRODUCTS, on their placeholders:
a. CURTAIN, the hero, x 0.656-0.712: natural linen-blend panel, fine slub stripes, warm oat-white, deep soft folds on matte black hooks at the corner of the ceiling track, hem touching the floor, overlapping the corner line.
b. WALL LAMP, x 0.436-0.464, y 0.244-0.306: hand-sized fluted half-cylinder up-and-down lamp, matte white reading as plaster, hardwired; the same lamp cut at the right edge.
c. BATH MAT before the shower: cream thick tufted cotton, raised border, half as long as the WC ledge.
d. ROLL STAND right of the ledge, against the wall: slim matte black standing roll holder, one plain spare roll, top below the ledge.
e. DIFFUSER on the ledge: milk-tea stone-look ceramic bottle, bamboo lid, 6-8 thin rattan reeds.
f. CANDLE at the ledge's left end: palm-sized ribbed matte white ceramic cup, warm-white wax, unlit.
g. PUMP BOTTLES in the niche: three sand ribbed ceramic bottles, matte black pumps, in a row filling half the niche width.
h. FLOOR PLANTER on its placeholder, pot x 0.49-0.555, y 0.75-0.877: a 30 cm straight natural seagrass basket (image 10) with a soft sage fern, fronds to about 1.2 m, clear of the wall lamp.
i. TOILET BRUSH on its placeholder, x 0.458-0.475, y 0.743-0.893: a slim matte black steel cylinder (image 11), 38 cm, the same black as the roll stand.

5. NOT IN FRAME: stool, ladder, towels, bin, any other plant, labels, glass, socket, cable, text, people. No snow. No sun patches, beams, bloom, haze, halos, HDR, grain or vignette.
